description: Frontend 2.0 information architecture contract for Phase 1. No real web app is started by this manifest.

staticPrototypes.title: Grading Report Local Core
dataSources: SQLite/JSON staging source is visible in GradingRecordReviewSummary

staticPrototypes.title: AI Task Center Mock
dataSources: realDemoReviewQueue.items[] -> synthetic read-only AI Task cards
latest GradingRecord source: LOCAL_SQLITE_GRADING_RECORD or JSON staging
requested taskId not found -> visible fallback selected task

staticPrototypes.title: Platform Entity Mock Store
dataSources: query: entityId, sourceTaskId, entityKind, coreDbPath, gradingDbPath, agentReport
query: action is accepted only as paused future handoff context
future handoff paused: import-send, import-status, import-result, platform signoff, final publish

pages.title: One-click Generation Workspace
pages.purpose: Generate Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT DSL from one local teaching source, keep all four tasks in WAITING_REVIEW, and route each artifact into human review.

pages.title: PPT Generation
pages.purpose: Generate a local Mock PPT DSL from a local Markdown source, keep the task review-gated, and route it to review without exposing provider credentials.

pages.title: Access Entrypoints
pages.purpose: Read-only local access entrypoint page that documents static previews and disabled IP plus port placeholders without starting a real server.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Show Phase 1 mock project status and review pressure.

pages.title: Mock Console
pages.purpose: Static Phase 1 console entry for navigating all mock pages, checking delivery readiness, and surfacing safety guardrails without starting a real frontend, agent, provider, cloud resource, sandbox, or publish action.

pages.title: Workflow Registry
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 2 Mock workflow capability catalog for selecting workflow definitions and MCP mock tools without executing workflows, creating AI tasks, writing artifacts, starting a real MCP server, or calling a real LLM.

pages.title: Real LLM Demo Evidence
pages.purpose: Show the replayed real LLM demo bundle, safe candidate preview, readonly evidence scoring result, and blocked actions without sending a new LLM request, reading secrets, executing contestant code, or publishing generated content.

pages.title: Audit Observability
pages.purpose: Read-only static Phase 1 audit observability page for Provider, MCP Tool, Workflow, Operation, and Review mock records without real providers, MCP servers, agents, cloud resources, sandbox execution, or publishing.

pages.title: Audit Detail
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 drilldown for one Provider or MCP audit record, including trace correlation, redacted argument preview, error context, and linked Workflow Run without retrying real calls.

pages.title: Audit Incident Review
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 incident review page that classifies failed Provider and MCP audit records into local operational suggestions without auto-fixing, retrying real calls, or starting agents.

pages.title: Operations Runbook
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 operations workbench that gathers local preview entries, whitelisted validation commands, audit review links, and guardrails without running commands or starting real services.

pages.title: Operations Acceptance
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 acceptance workbench that summarizes delivery readiness, runbook, FAQ, handoff checklist, readiness gate, and safe verification commands without uploading, publishing, or running commands.

pages.title: Operations Demo Map
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 demo path map that organizes all static mock pages by role and sequence without running commands, changing state, uploading packages, or publishing real content.

pages.title: Operations Presenter View
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 presenter view that condenses the operator demo script into speaker cues, validation signals, safe commands, and blocked actions without running commands, uploading packages, starting agents, or publishing real content.

pages.title: Operations Demo Script
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 operator demo script page that mirrors the local checklist, safe commands, acceptance signals, and blocked actions without running commands, uploading packages, or publishing real content.

pages.title: Operations Launchpad
pages.purpose: Read-only Phase 1 operator entry page that links local static mock pages, validation commands, handoff notes, and safety boundaries without running commands, uploading packages, or publishing real content.

pages.title: Delivery
pages.purpose: Show local Phase 1 delivery package readiness, acceptance checklist, phase1 check results, and safety assertions without exporting, uploading, or publishing real content.

pages.title: AI Task Center
pages.purpose: List AI tasks and inspect statuses.
dataSources: realDemoReviewQueue.items[] -> synthetic read-only AI Task cards
requested taskId not found -> visible fallback selected task

pages.title: Review Center
pages.purpose: Review local mock AI outputs and high-risk MCP intents without batch approval, real publishing, or second-factor confirmation.

pages.title: Platform Entity Mock Store
pages.purpose: Read local mock platform entity drafts created by lab/exam/grading/ppt mock-import without real database writes, real platform import, or publishing.
dataSources: query: entityId, sourceTaskId, entityKind, coreDbPath, gradingDbPath, agentReport
query: action is accepted only as paused future handoff context
future handoff paused: import-send, import-status, import-result, platform signoff, final publish

pages.title: Labs
pages.purpose: List local mock Lab records and route users to generation or human review without batch publishing.

pages.title: Lab Generation
pages.purpose: Start local core Lab DSL generation from Markdown and route the generated WAITING_REVIEW task into review and local import preview.

pages.title: Lab Review
pages.purpose: Approve or reject generated DSL after human review.

pages.title: Grading
pages.purpose: List local mock Grading DSL records and link to deterministic mock reports without executing contestant code.

pages.title: Grading Review
pages.purpose: Review generated Grading DSL and mock report preview without running sandbox or contestant code.

pages.title: Local Grading Workspace
pages.purpose: Create and synchronously run a local grading job with optional controlled Docker evidence, then record a human review on the derived GradingRecord without changing task approval or publishing.

pages.title: Grading Report
pages.purpose: Display local grading evidence and static fallback summaries for human review without initiating grading commands or executing contestant code from the page.

pages.title: Exams
pages.purpose: List local mock Exam records with grading DSL links while hiding standard answers from candidates.

pages.title: Exam Review
pages.purpose: Review generated Exam DSL and Grading DSL while keeping standard answers hidden from candidates.

pages.title: Exam Generation
pages.purpose: Create local core Exam DSL and Grading DSL from a Lab id, keep candidate answers protected, and route both artifacts into review and local import preview.

pages.title: PPT
pages.purpose: List local mock PPT DSL records and route users to generation or human review without generating real PPT files.

pages.title: PPT Review
pages.purpose: Review generated PPT DSL and slide plan while keeping real PPT file generation and publishing disabled.

pages.title: Environment Management
pages.purpose: List and manage local mock VM / Notebook records.

pages.title: Skills
pages.purpose: Browse reusable Phase 1 skills for operations.

pages.title: Provider Settings
pages.purpose: Show provider placeholder settings without secrets.
